variants.name: board: open orders (members join + status filter)
variants.sql: SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.status, o.total_cents FROM orders o JOIN store_members m ON m.store_id = o.store_id WHERE m.user_id = $1 AND o.store_id = $2 AND o.status <> 'done'

variants.name: board: customers (members join)
variants.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN store_members m ON m.store_id = c.store_id WHERE m.user_id = $1 AND c.store_id = $2

variants.name: board: counts per status (members join + GROUP BY)
variants.sql: SELECT o.status, count(*)::int AS orders FROM orders o JOIN store_members m ON m.store_id = o.store_id WHERE m.user_id = $1 AND o.store_id = $2 GROUP BY o.status

variants.name: join orders-customers, both pinned to the store
variants.sql: SELECT o.id, o.status, c.name AS customer FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.store_id = $1 AND c.store_id = $1

variants.name: plain + ORDER BY id, no LIMIT
variants.sql: SELECT id, status FROM orders WHERE store_id = $1 ORDER BY id

variants.name: plain + LIMIT 50, no ORDER BY
variants.sql: SELECT id, status FROM orders WHERE store_id = $1 LIMIT 50

variants.name: SELECT DISTINCT status
variants.sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders WHERE store_id = $1

variants.name: plain filter (control)
variants.sql: SELECT id, status, total_cents FROM orders WHERE store_id = $1
